title: Arabic word bank with English meanings
subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 94 (Arabic word bank with English meanings (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 94: Calligrams: shape poems in Arabic or English. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: What is a calligram?
points: Words make the shape of the subject
Objects and plants only: no living beings

parts.text: Body: lines of imagery: a flame of questions, glowing in the dark

keywords.def: a poem where the words form a picture of the subject
a poem written in the outline of its subject
the art of beautiful handwriting, prized in Islamic culture

questions.q: Choose your shape and say why it fits
questions.a: For example: a key, because learning opens doors

questions.q: Core: plan your calligram: shape, theme and six short lines of imagery
Extend: include at least one Arabic word with its meaning
questions.a: An Arabic word placed in the design

questions.q: Stretch: plan two levels of meaning (literal and personal)
questions.a: For example: a lantern that is also my teacher

questions.q: Which shape best fits a poem about patience growing over time?
questions.a: A) a tree. A tree grows slowly over time, like patience.
form the shape of the subject
